title: The Early train to the city
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：early　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 early 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the father wrote of ① an early train to the city in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② more early than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the early ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most early train to the city anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too early to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the early ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an early work of the poet, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as early as the work of the poet they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was early or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something early, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite early; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the early ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, in the rain, she wrote of another early train to the city in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more early than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most early work of the poet in the whole house, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the early ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 早（前置定语 an early train to the city：1951 年父亲在家书里记下的那件早的第一班车）
B. adj. 早／早期（比较级 more early than：文中两处，一处比进城的第一班车，一处比预想）
C. adj. 早／早期（最高级 the most early：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 早（表语 too early to do：母亲觉得它太早，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 早期（前置定语 an early work of the poet：叔叔把整件事称作一桩早期的作品）
F. adj. 早期（同级比较 as early as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩诗人早年的作品相比）
G. adj. 早期（后置定语 something early：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 早期（受程度副词修饰 quite early：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: an early train to the city
the most early train to the city anybody
an early work of the poet
The most early work of the poet in

answers.why: early 意为“早”，1951 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件早的第一班车”，此处作前置定语 an early train to the city。
early 意为“早”，此处用比较级 more early than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
early 意为“早”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最早的一件，故用最高级 the most early train to the city。
early 意为“早”，母亲认为这件东西“太早了，谁也用不上”，too early to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
early 意为“早期”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩早期的作品”，此处作前置定语 an early work of the poet。
early 意为“早期”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩诗人早年的作品一样早期”，同级比较用 as early as。
early 意为“早期”，家书上那半行字要的是“早期的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something early。
early 意为“早期”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当早期”，quite 修饰原级 early。
early 意为“早期”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要早期”，故用比较级 more early than。
early 意为“早期”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个老屋里最早期的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most early work of the poet。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件早的第一班车。（an early train to the city）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更早。（more early than …）
母亲觉得它太早，谁也用不上。（too early to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩早期的作品。（an early work of the poet）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩诗人早年的作品一样早期。（as early as …）
到了 1958 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件早期的东西。（something early）
answers: In 1951 the father wrote of an early train to the city in the letter.
Everybody said it was more early than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too early to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an early work of the poet.
He said nobody would call it as early as the work of the poet they had once had.
By 1958 the letter asked for nothing but something early.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 early 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the father wrote of an early train to the city in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most early train to the city in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too early to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an early work of the poet, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite early, and everybody laughed.
The early ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
